guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit network build contract – North Yorkshire
guard_streams.write_limit: Contracted premises and anticipated dates are planned procurement scope; further market research and engineering constraints can change the list.

facts.detail: The contract page was published on 25 July 2024.
Quickline is the awarded supplier.
The contract targets around 36,300 premises.
The contract value is £73.5 million.
The contract was signed in June 2024.
North Yorkshire Council is listed as collaborating on delivery.
The first premises were anticipated to gain access by the end of 2024.
A service can be requested after the network has been built.
Further market research can remove premises already reached by another provider.
Extraordinary engineering difficulties can change the contract scope.

guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit network build contract – Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly
guard_streams.write_limit: Contract scope is planned build evidence subject to supplier planning and technical change, not proof of present-day parcel service.

facts.detail: The contract page was published on 10 April 2024.
Wildanet is the awarded supplier.
The contract targets around 16,800 premises.
The contract value is £41.2 million.
The contract was signed in April 2024.

The first premises were anticipated to gain access in 2025.
Residents and businesses can request a connection after network build.
The premises list is subject to planning and technical change.
The page links a separate guidance page for additional Cornwall contracts.
